css: @charset "UTF-8"; body { font-family: 'Georgia','Times New Roman',serif; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.55; color: #000; } h1 { font-size: 22pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.8em; margin-bottom: 0.4em; padding-bottom: 0.2em; border-bottom: 2pt solid #000; page-break-after: avoid; } h2 { font-size: 17pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.3em; padding-bottom: 0.15em; border-bottom: 0.5pt solid #666; page-break-after: avoid; } h3 { font-size: 14pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.8em; margin-bottom: 0.2em; page-break-after: avoid; } h4 { font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.6em; margin-bottom: 0.2em; page-break-after: avoid; } table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0.8em 0; font-size: 9.5pt; page-break-inside: avoid; } th { background-color: #e8e8e8; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #333; } td { padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid #999; vertical-align: top; } tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #f5f5f5; } pre { background-color: #f0f0f0; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 8.5pt; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: pre-wrap; page-break-inside: avoid; margin: 0.6em 0; } code { font-family: 'Courier New',monospace; font-size: 9pt; background-color: #eee; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; } pre code { background: none; padding: 0; font-size: 8.5pt; } blockquote { border-left: 3px solid #555; margin: 0.6em 0; padding: 0.3em 0.8em; color: #333; background-color: #f8f8f8; font-style: italic; page-break-inside: avoid; } blockquote p { margin: 0.3em 0; } ul, ol { margin: 0.4em 0; padding-left: 1.5em; } li { margin-bottom: 0.2em; } a { color: #000; text-decoration: underline; } hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #999; margin: 1.2em 0; } .page-break { page-break-after: always; } p { margin: 0.4em 0; } img { max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 1em auto; page-break-inside: avoid; }
